datasets.name: Bijie Landslide open source dataset
datasets.verbatim: To guarantee a fair comparison, the involved dataset is Bijie Landslide open source dataset [13], which is an optical remote sensing landslide image dataset collected by research groups in Wuhan University.

datasets.name: Luding landslide image set
datasets.verbatim: Fu et al. [97] published a series of real landslide scenarios in Luding, which includes 200 optical remote sensing images on earthquake-included landslides captured by GF-6 satellite on September 5, 2022.

methods.name: Interpretability improved three-branched evidential fusion
methods.summary: A fusion framework that integrates evidence from multiple channelwise-fused images (H, S, V channels) using a new Belief Jensen-Renyi (BJR) divergence and a three-branched weighting mechanism (supporting degree, information volume, and improved information volume) to manage evidence conflict and improve classification accuracy.
methods.source: Jiaxu Zhang, Qi Cui, and Xiaojian Ma

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are known to be publicy available. The custom code is available via a provided GitHub repository link.
